rows: Benchmark, n=1 because the question is whether the port is slower, not by how much: the whole suite took 425 s in Rust (`cargo test`, one test binary at a time, tests in parallel inside it) and about 11 minutes in TypeScript (`vitest run`, 4 workers; `ts-clean.log` timestamps 10:31 to 10:42). The Rust suite needs no Node install to run. Decision: keep the Rust suite as the only gate; CI and the pre-commit secrets job now call `cargo test -p wf-blackbox --test ...` against the installed `wf`.
